title: afm config
description: Schema for an afm config.yaml (.afm/config.yaml or ~/.afm/config.yaml). See https://akopichin.github.io/afm/config-reference/

prompts_dir.description: Directory with custom prompt templates; missing files fall back to the embedded defaults.

theme.description: Dashboard theme. Default graphite. "coffee" is a legacy alias for graphite.

skills_dir.description: Default extra local skill library for runs: a directory of <name>/SKILL.md folders. A flow, stage or team member skills_dir wins over it; libraries are never merged. A relative path is resolved from the effective project root, not from the config directory; use an absolute path for a shared library. Empty values, a leading ~ and control characters are rejected.

skin_dir.description: A fully custom dashboard skin directory (containing index.css). Overrides `theme`.

auto_recover.description: Auto-reset failed stages to pending on run start/resume. Default true.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks: observer commands receiving event JSON on stdin (global/project layers).

collaboration.description: The helper-agent ("collaboration") feature: side helpers/sub-tasks a stage agent can delegate to. Precedence for enabled: env AFM_COLLABORATION > this > default ON.

enabled.description: Enable collaboration. ON by default; explicit false / env AFM_COLLABORATION=0 disables it.

max_depth.description: Maximum helper delegation depth. Explicit 0 means no helpers at all. Unset falls back to the project/global layer, then a built-in default of 3 (see assistants.ResolveDepth) — a flow.yaml collaboration.max_depth can override this further.

mode.description: Dashboard collaboration mode. team (default) shows Team, Board and People; assistants hides them and keeps the helpers under stages. Affects the UI only, not whether collaboration is enabled. Unset falls back to the other config layer, then team; a flow.yaml collaboration.mode can override this further.

profiles.description: Locally configured assistant roles, keyed by profile id. No marketplace: builtin + global config + project config are the only sources.

command.description: An already-configured command/recipe name to run this profile with (not a new binary/transport). A built-in profile with no command inherits client.command.

delegate.description: Allow this profile to create its own child tasks (recursive delegation). Default false — delegation is opt-in per profile because it spawns additional helper subprocesses.

collaborationLimits.description: Delegation/quota limits for the collaboration feature.

max_tasks.description: Whole-run ceiling on the total number of helper tasks (top-level attaches plus every delegated descendant). Unset = unlimited.

sideAgent.description: The dashboard side-agent (chat helper). Precedence: flow.yaml side_agent > env AFM_SIDEAGENT > this > default ON.

enabled.description: Enable the side-agent. ON by default; explicit false / env AFM_SIDEAGENT=0 disables it.

addStage.description: Adding stages to a running flow (dashboard "+ Stage" button, graph API, agent proposals). Precedence: env AFM_ADD_STAGE > project > global > default ON.

enabled.description: Allow adding stages during a run. ON by default; explicit false / env AFM_ADD_STAGE=0 hides the button and rejects graph changes.

worktrees.description: Per-flow git worktrees: each flow runs in a dedicated worktree on a branch named after the flow. Precedence: flow.yaml worktrees > env AFM_WORKTREES > this > default OFF.

enabled.description: Enable per-flow git worktrees. OFF by default; env AFM_WORKTREES overrides; flow.yaml worktrees overrides both.

browser.description: Managed Chrome DevTools browser capability (afm_chrome MCP). Drives a real Chrome on the host so a stage agent can run the app for real, in Docker or native.

enabled.description: Tri-state: omitted = auto (offered on a supported host, Chrome launches on first use); true = on (preflight must succeed or the run fails); false = fully off. AFM_BROWSER=1/0 overrides.

headless.description: Launch Chrome without a visible window. Default visible.

app_port.description: Port the tested app is served on. Default 18080. Must differ from server.port.

executable_path.description: Override the Chrome binary location (default: macOS Google Chrome).

verify.description: Global verify-gate settings. A per-stage override lives inside the stage's verify block (container form).

max_failures.description: How many verify rejections (needs_changes) are allowed before the stage fails: N = number of retry-corrections. Default 1; 0 = fail on the first rejection.

review_patience.description: How many CONSECUTIVE verify rejections that left the working tree unchanged are tolerated before the stage is accepted as complete (reviewer/author stalemate). Default 0 = disabled. For this to engage, max_failures must be >= review_patience (otherwise the stage fails on the failure budget first and the setting is a silent no-op). A per-stage override lives inside the stage's verify block (container form).

fresh_correction.description: Give the author a FRESH session (no --resume) when AI-verify returns needs_changes, reconstructing the lost context from the action log, the prior user Q&A and verify/feedback.md. Default true; false keeps the pre-existing resume-the-same-session behavior. A per-stage override lives inside the stage's verify block (container form).

usageLimit.description: How a stage waits out a provider usage limit (subscription window or quota): it parks in awaiting_quota instead of failing, without spending retries.

resume_margin.description: Extra time after the reported reset before the stage wakes. Must be positive. Default 60s.

probe_interval.description: How often to re-check the limit when the reset time is unknown. Must be positive. Default 15m.

max_wait.description: A reset later than this is not waited for: the stage is paused with a reason. Must be positive. Default 12h.

max_waits.description: How many consecutive limit refusals without progress are waited out before the stage is paused. Default 4.

accounting.description: Cost/usage accounting DISPLAY switch (dashboard cost UI, `afm check` cost columns, `afm report`). Collection into usage.jsonl is unaffected.

enabled.description: Show accounting. ON by default; explicit false / env AFM_ACCOUNTING=0 hides the display (data is still collected).

show_money.description: Show monetary ($) values. OFF by default — only tokens are shown; true / env AFM_ACCOUNTING_SHOW_MONEY=1 also shows cost. Presentation-only (cost is still collected in usage.jsonl).

command.description: The AI command to run as the agent. Default "claude".

extra_args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command.

claude_bare.description: Add --bare to generated claude wrappers (lighter, but disables skill auto-discovery). Default false.

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for the default claude client, mapped to --effort (author stages, side agent, JSON-repair helper and memory rebuild; the AI verify reviewer does not get it). Levels: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max (clamped to claude's set). Works on host and in Docker. Not an enum: an unknown value is not rejected by afm run's preflight (which forwards it and prints a warning), but the backend may reject it and fail that invocation. afm memory rebuild forwards the value without the preflight warning.

idle_timeout.description: Max idle time with no agent output before the process is killed. Default 30m.

max_parallel.description: Max stages running in parallel (0 = unlimited).

truncate_output.description: Max chars of agent text/Bash detail logged (0 = no limit).

open_browser.description: Open the dashboard in a browser on startup. Default false.

enabled.description: Enable Docker mode. Unset falls back to $AFM_USE_DOCKER.

image.description: Docker image to run. Default akopichin/afm:latest.

autoShim.description: Generate claude-compatible wrappers for docker.agents inside the container.

secrets_file.description: Optional path to a file with secrets for autoShim auth.from lookups.

extra_mounts.description: Extra host paths mounted into the container (:ro). Each item is a string or an object.

file_browser.description: The dashboard project file browser (Docker mode only).

enabled.description: Enable the file browser. ON by default; env AFM_FILE_BROWSER overrides.

agentRecipe.description: An autoShim wrapper recipe for a custom agent command.

system_prompt.description: Optional "file:<path>" whose content is appended as the system prompt.

max_turns.description: openai-agent only: max tool-call iterations per invocation (0 = default 40).

reasoning.description: Reasoning effort for this recipe, clamped to the family mechanism (codex model_reasoning_effort / claude --effort / openai reasoning_effort). Levels: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Docker-only (wrappers are generated in the container); cursor ignores it. Not an enum: an unknown value is not rejected by afm run's preflight (which forwards it and prints a warning), but the backend may reject it and fail that invocation.

recipeAuth.description: Where afm reads the secret on the host (from) and which env var the wrapper exports (to).

from.description: "env:VAR" or "file:<path>" — the secret source on the host.

to.description: "env:<VAR>" — the env var the generated wrapper exports.

pricing.description: Overrides/extends the built-in accounting rate table (list-price USD per 1M tokens — an estimate, not a bank charge).

rateCard.description: A (possibly partial) set of category rates, decimal USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Omitted = fall back to the built-in default; explicit 0 disables that category's cost.

cache_write.description: Cache-write fallback for a TTL with no specific rate.

extraMount.description: Either a bare host path string (browse:false), or an object.

anyOf.description: Legacy scalar form: a host path (browse:false).

name.description: Optional UI label for the file browser.

browse.description: Expose this mount in the file browser. Default false.

lifecycleHook.description: A lifecycle hook: an observer command that receives the event JSON payload on stdin. Its exit status never affects the flow.

id.description: Unique hook id within its layer; also the hook log file name (must be a safe path component).

command.description: The command line, run via `sh -c` with the event JSON payload on stdin.

retries.description: Extra retry attempts after a non-zero exit. Default 0 (single attempt).

env.description: Hook process env: target var -> env:NAME | file:PATH source reference

inherit_env.description: Inherit the whole afm process environment. Default false (minimal env).

lifecycleEventSelector.description: Either the scalar "all", or a non-empty list of event names (validated by afm at load time).
